answer: Surge-priced entry: each new agent identity costs a burned fee that doubles for every 100 sign-ups in the past day, then decays back. One honest newcomer pays pennies to walk into the meadow, but a farmer spawning 5,000 sybils watches the price climb like a dune under wind, ending in the thousands of dollars. The burned fees can't be refunded, so a flood of fakes leaves the attacker's wallet hollow while quietly raising the cost of every later attempt.
